versions.changelog:
Initial release of Financial Advisor skill, providing institutional-grade financial analysis and investment advisory features.

- Enables real-time and historical data collection for stocks, funds, and ETFs.
- Supports technical indicator calculation, risk assessment, and valuation modeling (DCF, comparable company, financial statement).
- Integrates macroeconomic, geopolitical, and trending news analysis.
- Delivers AI-driven reports with investment recommendations and in-depth quantitative and qualitative insights.
- Generates interactive HTML reports summarizing core metrics, risk analysis, market intelligence, and actionable strategies.
